Resolves #20211

Passes `mapId: id` to `destroyMarkers`, iterates `this.markerStore.forEach(...)`, and spreads `...(item.toJSON?.() || item)` in [`Neo.component.wrapper.OpenStreetMaps#onMarkerStoreLoad`](src/component/wrapper/OpenStreetMaps.mjs) so `destroyMarkers` receives `mapId` and `addMarker` receives each `Neo.data.Record` instance's serialized fields via [`Record#toJSON()`](src/data/RecordFactory.mjs) (mirroring the wrapper side of `#20209`; OpenLayers addon marker lifecycle remains in `#6610`).

Evidence: L1 (unit test tier in Node.js) → L1 required (AC-1, AC-2).

Micro-review eligible: narrow bugfix — mirrors the merged GoogleMaps wrapper fix (#20209) in `Neo.component.wrapper.OpenStreetMaps#onMarkerStoreLoad` and adds a focused unit spec.
